name: semantic_spine_repair
purpose: Public-safe structural fixture for PIE 0.1 semantic-spine consolidation without copying source headings, mutable inventories, or narrow rules over broad boundaries.
natural_request: 请检查并整理这个 ChatGPT Project 的长期 instructions。目标是保留真正长期有效的规则，把易变细节交回权威来源，合并重复含义，保护授权、隐私、安全和证据边界。允许 no-op、局部修改或有限整理，优先最小必要修改。
live_setting_summary: Current setting says real production changes require explicit current-task authorization for the concrete object, purpose, and scope.
Current setting also has a narrower client-channel change rule with the same authorization consequence.
Current setting copies a volatile supported-client list even though docs/current-support.md owns the list.
Current setting has two normal answer-behavior sections that both say to answer with conclusion, user action, then evidence.
Current setting has a distinct release-closure report trigger that should not be merged into normal answer behavior.
Current setting contains ordinary English source labels such as delivery mode, client inventory, support matrix, and evidence packet.
Current setting preserves privacy, current-evidence, fail-closed, uncertainty, and exact-identity requirements.
targeted_history_summary: A previous auto-send-beta-summary rule was explicitly rejected and is absent from the live setting.
The current request says not to reintroduce rejected history.
The user accepted that docs/current-support.md owns the mutable supported-client list.
The user accepted that docs/operations-policy.md owns detailed production-change procedures.

canonical_sources.README.md: Repository overview and project scope locator.
canonical_sources.AGENTS.md: Build, test, and workflow detail locator.
canonical_sources.docs/operations-policy.md: Production mutation, authorization, privacy, safety, and fail-closed procedure locator.

scope_dominance.broad_rule: All real production changes require explicit current-task authorization for the concrete object, purpose, and scope.
scope_dominance.narrow_rule: Client-channel changes also require explicit current-task authorization.
scope_dominance.expected: The broad production authorization boundary remains; the narrow rule is retained only if it adds useful action-specific detail.

dynamic_set_abstraction.expected: Use a lookup bridge for all currently supported clients/channels defined by docs/current-support.md instead of freezing the current members.

trigger_consequence_merge.expected: Overlapping normal answer rules have one primary home.
trigger_consequence_merge.distinct_trigger: Formal release-closure report remains distinct if needed.

protected_absence.expected: The deleted rule and its deletion history remain absent from the final setting.
